diagnoses.title: ErrorBudgetBurn

root_causes.cause: The paymentFailure flag (flagd) is enabled at variant 50%, so payment's Charge path throws 'Payment request failed. Invalid token' for roughly half of targeted requests. This produces the ~24-37% error ratio with fast failures and no dependency or pod faults.

Less likely: a code-level token-validation fault in payment's charge.js introduced by the 3.1.0-payment image (single revision at 18:45:56Z). The flag evidence makes this unlikely, and the rollout came about 19 minutes before onset.

diagnoses.title: LatencyP95High

root_causes.cause: product-catalog's GetProduct/ListProducts handling slows sharply from about 19:15Z. Its own self time is about 5s per call, and its astronomy-db client spans rise to 2-4s. Possible mechanisms are database-connection or pool waiting inside product-catalog, or an in-process code path. The 10x load increase from about 18:50Z is a plausible trigger.
The PostgreSQL side may be slow (locks, slow queries or connection contention). This is unverified: astronomy-db's own server-side spans and logs were not checked, and its CPU stayed low.
